name: TensorPM v1.44.1
body:
# Changelog - v1.44.1

This patch brings documents you keep in the `exports/artifacts` folder back to the Distiller,
lets you set aside a whole folder of new signals in one step, and adds a way to restore the
TensorPM icon on your Windows desktop.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Your documents in `exports/artifacts` reach the Distiller again:** since 1.40.2, the
  Distiller skipped every file in `exports/artifacts`, including documents you filed there
  yourself, such as meeting briefings in a subfolder. Now it only skips the documents TensorPM
  exports there itself. Your own files show up as new signals again.

## 🎨 Improvements

- **See where a signal comes from:** each file in the _Incoming Signals_ list shows the folder it
  sits in, and the search also finds signals by folder name.
- **Ignore a whole folder in one step:** when a folder holds five or more new signals, a line
  above the list offers _Ignore folder_. After you confirm, the Distiller skips those signals
  and any new files in that folder. You can undo it under _Ignored Signals_.
- **Restore the desktop icon (Windows):** an update does not bring back a TensorPM icon that has
  gone missing from the desktop. _Settings → Info → More → Restore desktop shortcut_ creates it
  again. The option is available when TensorPM was installed with the Setup.exe installer.

## 📝 Notes

- After the update, documents you filed in `exports/artifacts` may appear as new signals. If you
  have already captured them, use _Ignore folder_ to set them aside.

---
